# Rhemic AI - LLM Context File
# https://rhemicai.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-07-30

## What Rhemic AI is

Rhemic AI is a search and answer-engine visibility firm for local and SMB service businesses.

We help a business show up everywhere its customers look: Google search, the local map, and AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot. That is the whole thesis. One company, one job.

Rhemic is a done-for-you service firm. It is not a self-serve software product, it has no free trial, and it does not sell a white-label platform to agencies.

## What problem Rhemic solves

Customers no longer scroll ten links. They ask Google or an AI engine who to go with, then contact whoever looks most trusted and answers first. A business loses customers when it does not rank on Google, is not named in AI answers, has a thin Google Business Profile, or cannot catch the calls and forms that demand creates.

Rhemic runs the technical visibility stack that fixes all four, and reports the result against citation share and booked work.

Rhemic does not guarantee specific rankings or revenue. Results depend on third-party platforms.

## The four service lines

1. AEO, answer engine optimization. Make the business the named answer when a buyer asks an AI engine who to call. Prompt-level auditing across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot. Citation share measured against named competitors. Entity and schema work so an engine has an extractable fact to quote. Answer-page architecture.

2. GEO, generative engine optimization. The source side of the same problem. Get the business represented in the places generative engines ground on: review platforms, directories, community threads, industry roundups and comparison content.

3. SEO, technical and local organic. Indexation, crawl access, site architecture, internal linking, service and service-plus-location pages, schema markup, page speed. The half that decides whether the AEO work has anything to stand on.

4. Google Business Profile optimization. Categories, services, attributes, hours, service areas, photos, posts, Q&A, review velocity and response, NAP consistency, map pack ranking, and suspension recovery. For a local service business this is frequently the highest-revenue surface on the internet.

## The instrumentation layer, included

- Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools set up, verified, monitored and reported
- IndexNow configured
- Structured data: Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ, Article, BreadcrumbList
- Sitemaps, robots.txt, llms.txt, canonical hygiene, 404 and redirect cleanup
- Bing AI citation reporting, which is the closest thing to a scoreboard for answer-engine work
- GA4 and conversion instrumentation so visibility ties back to booked revenue

## Who Rhemic serves

Owner-led local service businesses in the United States, roughly $500k to $5M in revenue, single location up to about five. Home services lead: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, auto repair. Also clinics, dental, restaurants, salons, cleaning, landscaping and similar local service categories.

Rhemic does not serve enterprise AI visibility monitoring, national brands, or e-commerce.

## Plans

Every price is published.

- Visibility: $200/month. Get found and recommended. AEO, GEO, SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
- Capture: $700/month. Everything in Visibility, plus the capture layer and lead tracker for calls, missed calls, after-hours inquiries and forms.
- Full done-for-you system: $2,000/month. Everything in Capture, plus multi-location routing, deeper reporting, and spend tied to booked-work outcomes.
- No website? We build one as part of getting you visible, with no separate web-design bill.

The next step is a free AI visibility scan and a free 20-minute audit.
